text: dsh-conversation-files 是一个 DSH 网页插件，在侧边栏提供跨对话文件图库。它读取会话事件中的文件写入、编辑、补丁和交付调用，把同一路径合并后按类型分组。用户可以搜索文件名或路径，按来源、类型和扩展名筛选，并在网格与列表视图间切换。图片、文本和部分文档可在面板中预览，也可查看来源对话、写入次数和时间。适合需要找回助手在不同会话中产出文件的 DSH 用户；需要 DSH web client，macOS 才支持 QuickLook 缩略图及原生打开、Finder 和废纸篓操作。

This DSH web plugin adds a sidebar gallery for files the assistant wrote, edited, or delivered across conversations. It groups files by path, with search, filters, grid and list views, previews, and file actions. It requires a DSH web client; macOS is needed for QuickLook and native actions.
想把助手在不同对话里生成的文件集中找出来

能不能直接预览之前某个对话写出的文件？
帮我找回助手交付过但后来从磁盘删掉的文件记录
想按文件名或完整路径搜索会话里生成的文件
Show me files the assistant created across my conversations.
Can I browse and preview files produced in earlier DSH chats?
dsh-conversation-files 的功能「跨会话文件汇总」：主机读取多个会话的事件日志，只保留文件写入、编辑、补丁和交付调用，并按路径合并，提供名称、来源会话、写入次数与时间。 通过侧栏图库中的搜索、卡片或操作菜单触发。
dsh-conversation-files 的功能「搜索与分类」：侧栏图库可按文件名或路径搜索，并按写入/交付状态、文件类型和扩展名筛选；用户也可在网格和列表布局间切换。 通过侧栏图库中的搜索、卡片或操作菜单触发。
dsh-conversation-files 的功能「文件预览」：图库为图片、文本及支持的文档提供缩略图或面板预览，并限制文件类型、大小和读取行数；用户可从卡片查看产出内容。 通过侧栏图库中的搜索、卡片或操作菜单触发。
dsh-conversation-files 的功能「打开和管理文件」：用户可通过卡片操作使用默认应用或选择应用打开文件、在 Finder 中定位，或将文件移入废纸篓；也可复制路径。 通过侧栏图库中的搜索、卡片或操作菜单触发。
文档缩略图依赖 macOS QuickLook；原生打开、Finder 定位和移入废纸篓也需要 macOS。见 lib/index.js:121-123、893-930、1061-1102。

dsh-conversation-files README · dsh-conversation-files：A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web plugin: a left-sidebar entry that gathers **every file the assistant generated for you — across all conversations** — into one gallery panel, grouped by file type.

Click 对话文件 (folder icon, below SSH) in the left sidebar to open the panel.

> 中文版: [README.zh.md](./README.zh.md)

dsh-conversation-files README · What shows up：The panel replays the event log of every conversation in the profile and keeps only files the assistant *produced*:

| kind | where it comes from |
| --- | --- |
| 写入 / Written | files written, edited or patched by tools (`write`, `edit`, `apply_patch`, …) |
| 交付 / Delivered | files handed over by `present`-style tools |

Read-only touches (`read`, `view_image`, …) and user attachments are deliberately **not** generated files and never appear here.

Files are grouped by extension:

dsh-conversation-files README · What shows up：| group | extensions |
| --- | --- |
| 图片 / Images | png jpg jpeg webp gif svg bmp avif ico |
| 文档 / Documents | md mdx txt rtf pdf doc docx docm dot dotx odt pages epub |
| 表格 / Spreadsheets | xls xlsx xlsm xlsb numbers ods csv tsv |
| 演示文稿 / Slides | ppt pptx pptm pps ppsx pot potx key odp |
| 代码 / Code | js mjs cjs ts tsx jsx py rb go rs java kt c cc cpp h hpp cs swift sh bash zsh ps1 css scss less html htm vue lua php |
| 配置 / Config | json jsonc json5 yaml yml toml ini conf cfg env gitignore plist lock |
| 数据 / Data | jsonl ndjson xml parquet sqlite db sql |
| 压缩包 / Archives | zip tar gz tgz bz2 xz 7z rar dmg iso |
| 音视频 / Media | mp3 wav m4a flac aac ogg opus mp4 mov mkv webm avi |
| 其他 / Other | everything else (e.g. ttf woff) |

dsh-conversation-files README · What shows up：| card type | thumbnail |
| --- | --- |
| images | the image itself, downscaled by the browser |
| code, text, config | the first 8 lines of the file in a small monospace block, faded at the bottom |
| markdown | the same, with heading markers, list bullets and emphasis stripped so it reads like prose |
| PDF / Word / PowerPoint / Excel / iWork | the first page, rendered on demand by macOS QuickLook |
| everything else (archives, media, binaries) | a large extension label plus a type icon |

dsh-conversation-files README · What shows up：Every card carries the extension in its top-right corner and shows the conversation it came from (plus `+N` when more conversations touched it), how many times it was written, its size and the time of the last write. The full path is in the tooltip.

**Clicking a card opens the file with its default application.** The ⋮ button in the bottom-right corner opens a menu (pop/fade animation both ways):

dsh-conversation-files README · What shows up：| menu entry | action |
| --- | --- |
| 使用默认应用打开 / Open with default app | hands the file to `open` |
| 选择应用打开 / Open with… | a second menu listing the apps macOS can open this file with (the default one first, then *Other…* for the system chooser) |
| 在 Finder 中打开 / Show in Finder | `open -R` |
| 移到废纸篓 / Move to Trash | moves the file into `~/.Trash` (recoverable), after a confirmation |

dsh-conversation-files README · What shows up：Files that no longer exist on disk are **not** part of 全部: they get their own 已删除 chip, a red 已删除 badge and no thumbnail.

Interactions:

dsh-conversation-files README · What shows up：- **Fold a group** — click its header; the grid animates closed and the fold state is persisted in `localStorage`.
- **Filter by kind** — chips: 全部 (existing files) / 写入 / 交付 / 已删除.
- **Filter by file type** — the 全部类型 dropdown narrows to one group (with live counts).
- **Filter by extension** — the 全部后缀 dropdown lists only the extensions present **in the current type filter** (选「文档」时只剩 md/docx/pdf…), most common first; picking a type that no longer contains the chosen extension resets it to 全部后缀.
- **Search** — filters by file name or full path.
- **Switch views** — the 网格 / 列表 buttons at the right of the toolbar flip between the card grid and a compact list (thumbnail, name, source conversation · writes · size · date, extension badge, ⋮ menu). The choice is persisted in `localStorage`.
- Switching the view, the kind chips, the type filter or the extension filter replays a staggered *expand* transition — grid cards pop in from `scale(.92)` and list rows unfold from a squashed bar, 14 ms apart.
- Group headers are sticky while scrolling; the panel refreshes every 5 s while visible and skips polling while the window is hidden.

dsh-conversation-files README · How it works：- **Host** (`lib/index.js`)
  - `GET /dsh-conversation-files/generated` — `sessionQuery.listSessions()` → skip `origin: 'subagent'` → batch titles via `readTitleSnapshots` → read each log (live sessions from memory, persisted ones via `readSession`) → parse only `tool/call` arguments (never `tool/result`, whose `meta.path` is the *operated-on* file) → canonicalise paths with `realpathSync` → merge per path across conversations → `stat` the first 400 → sort by last write, newest first.
  - `GET /dsh-conversation-files/thumb?path=…` — returns image bytes only for files that appear in the most recent scan, only for image extensions, only up to 12 MB.
  - `GET /dsh-conversation-files/text?path=…` — the first 40 lines of a generated text file (≤ 256 KB, binary files rejected), used for the code/markdown previews.
  - `GET /dsh-conversation-files/preview?path=…&size=…` — a page thumbnail for a generated document, rendered with `qlmanage -t` and cached in `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-conversation-files/previews/` (one PNG + one JSON of `{mtimeMs,size}` per file, keyed by path hash and size), memory-cached per process.
  - `GET /dsh-conversation-files/raw?
dsh-conversation-files README · How it works：Caching happens at three levels, so the panel is never stuck on a loading screen for long:

dsh-conversation-files README · How it works：1. Per-session results (live sessions keyed by sequence number, persisted ones for 60 s).
2. A full snapshot persisted to `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-conversation-files/generated.json`. A snapshot younger than 10 minutes is served as-is; one younger than a day is served immediately and rebuilt in the background (the footer shows 「后台更新中」).
3. The panel keeps its last payload in memory, so switching panels and coming back renders the grid instantly.
dsh-conversation-files README · How it works：A warm-up scan runs five seconds after the host starts, so even a cold process has a snapshot ready before you click the sidebar entry.

dsh-conversation-files README · Limits：- Files written through `bash` redirections (`>`, `tee`, …) are invisible — that is not a structured write call. Only tool arguments are parsed.
- A file with a `.conf` / `.lock` extension lands in 配置; unknown extensions (fonts, binaries) land in 其他.

dsh-conversation-files README · Install：```sh
git clone https://github.com/Shall0vv/dsh-conversation-files
```

Then, in DSH:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle target=<absolute path to the cloned folder>
```

To update an installed copy, remove it first:

```
plugin_manager remove_bundle  target=dsh-conversation-files
plugin_manager install_bundle target=<absolute path to the cloned folder>
```

dsh-conversation-files README · Install：The bundle is linked into `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` and listed in `dsh.profile.bundles`, so it survives a restart. Removing the bundle from the profile removes the sidebar entry.

dsh-conversation-files README · Requirements：- macOS, for the QuickLook thumbnails (`qlmanage`), the Trash move (`~/.Trash`) and the app list / open-with picker (`osascript` + `NSWorkspace`). The gallery itself, the text previews and the filters work anywhere.
- DSH with a `web` client bundle — no extra dependencies.
